  "assessment": "The source supports the normalized-friction fits for the viscous-inertial transition. The public control St ranges from 0.01 to 300. The common fixed condition K_phi = J + 0.1 I^2 = 0.065 is a constructed slice through both source global fits, not two simulation runs from the two matched mu_f branches. The St=.65 and 206.5 points are provenance for how the reference slice was chosen, not paired direct samples. The derived relations J(St)=0.065/(1+0.1 St), K_mu(St)=0.065*(1+alpha_mu St)/(1+0.1 St), and r(St)=1+a_mu*sqrt(K_mu(St)) are consistent with the source equations and fits. The private branch mu_f=0.15 uses a_mu=14.3 and alpha_mu=0.029; the alternate branch mu_f=0.80 uses a_mu=26.5 and alpha_mu=0.00875. All constants are anchored. The case is authoring-ready.",
